note: Submodule of taxonomy_machine_name. It provides a Search API processor 'taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy' (AddHierarchy - indexes a taxonomy term machine_name field plus all ancestor machine names) and a Views filter 'search_api_taxonomy_machine_name' with Start-at-level/Max-depth options. Medium/hard cases are grounded in a fully namespaced, self-contained Search API index built by the setup/reset scripts: a search_api_db server 'satmn_server' + DISABLED index 'satmn_index' (node datasource) + an article->tags entity_reference field field_satmn_cat + an index field field_satmn_cat_machine_name that indexes the referenced term's machine_name (its field dependencies include the taxonomy_machine_name module, which is what makes the processor supportable). Introspection reads back that the hierarchy processor is enabled and which field it targets; execution adds the processor / enables hierarchy for the field, verified against the stored index config. Cleanups/teardown fully remove the namespaced index, server and field. The index is left DISABLED to avoid indexing churn on the shared site.

evals.prompt: What does the Search API Taxonomy Machine Name submodule's search processor do, and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: It provides the processor taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy ('Index machine name hierarchy', class AddHierarchy) which, for the configured taxonomy machine_name fields, adds every ancestor term's machine_name to the indexed value (loadAllParents) so a search on a parent category also matches descendants.

evals.prompt: How do you filter a Search API view by taxonomy term machine name using the search_api_taxonomy_machine_name submodule, and what extra options does its filter add over the base module's filter?
evals.expected_output: Add the machine-name field's filter to a Search API view; hook_views_data_alter automatically maps it to the search_api_taxonomy_machine_name handler. It adds 'Start at level' (hierarchy_parent) and 'Max depth' (hierarchy_max_depth) options that feed loadTree(), on top of the base taxonomy_index_machine_name filter's options.

evals.prompt: When is the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy Search API processor available to add to an index, and what does it do to Solr field mappings when enabled?
evals.expected_output: It is available only when the index has a field whose dependencies include the taxonomy_machine_name module (i.e. a term machine_name field). When enabled it makes the affected Solr fields multi-value (sm_ prefixed) via hook_search_api_solr_field_mapping_alter -> alterFieldMapping.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Search API index named satmn_index. Inspect its live configuration and state whether the search_api_taxonomy_machine_name hierarchy processor is enabled on it, giving the processor's plugin id.
evals.expected_output: Yes - the satmn_index has the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy processor enabled (visible via $index->getProcessors() or the index's processor_settings).

evals.prompt: The Search API index satmn_index on this site has the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy processor enabled. Inspect the processor's live configuration and report the machine name of the index field for which hierarchical machine-name indexing is turned on.
evals.expected_output: The processor's configuration has fields.field_satmn_cat_machine_name.status = true, so hierarchy indexing is enabled for the index field field_satmn_cat_machine_name.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index satmn_index has a taxonomy term machine-name field (field_satmn_cat_machine_name) but is not indexing the term hierarchy. Using the search_api_taxonomy_machine_name submodule, add its machine-name hierarchy processor to this index so ancestor machine names get indexed. Apply the change to the live index.
evals.expected_output: Add the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy processor to satmn_index (e.g. create it via the search_api processor plugin manager with fields[field_satmn_cat_machine_name][status]=TRUE, $index->addProcessor($proc); $index->save()). getProcessors() then includes taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy.

evals.prompt: The Search API index satmn_index has the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy processor, but hierarchical machine-name indexing is currently turned off for its field field_satmn_cat_machine_name. Turn it on for that field and save the change to the live index.
evals.expected_output: In the taxonomy_machine_name_hierarchy processor configuration on satmn_index set fields.field_satmn_cat_machine_name.status to TRUE (update the processor configuration and save the index).
